text: Vel Tech Multi Tech Engineering College maintains a strong placement record with approximately 75-80% of eligible students getting placed every year. The Training and Placement Cell actively coordinates with 100+ companies for campus recruitment. The placement season typically runs from August to April each year.

The average salary package for placed students is approximately ₹3.0 to ₹4.5 LPA (Lakhs Per Annum). The highest package offered has been approximately ₹12 LPA. CSE and AI&DS students typically receive higher packages due to strong IT sector demand. Mechanical and Civil engineering students receive packages in the range of ₹2.5 to ₹3.5 LPA.

Top recruiting companies include: IT/Software — TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, HCL Technologies, Tech Mahindra, Zoho Corporation, Accenture, Capgemini, Mphasis, and Mindtree. Core Engineering — L&T, Ashok Leyland, TVS Motor, Hyundai, Sundaram Fasteners. Banking/Finance — HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank.

The Training and Placement Cell provides pre-placement training including: aptitude and reasoning workshops, group discussion practice, mock interviews, resume building sessions, soft skills and communication training, technical skill workshops (coding, problem-solving), and personality development programs. Training begins from the 2nd year itself.

Internship opportunities are facilitated by the placement cell with companies like TCS, Infosys, and local startups. Summer internships (6-8 weeks) are available after the 2nd and 3rd years. Many students convert their internships into full-time job offers. The college also supports students in applying for internships through platforms like Internshala and LinkedIn.
